2. The petitioner seeks bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 3 (i) (w), 3 (2) (v) of the Scheduled Caste & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and Sections 4 & 6 of the POCSO Act.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Vide order dated 12.07.2024, a report was called for, regarding the stage of trial.

In compliance thereof, a report sent by learned Exclusive Special Judge POCSO cum Additional Sessions Judge-VII, Gaya dated 27.07.2024 is kept at flag 'R', whereby it is submitted that out of six witnesses mentioned in the charge-sheet, four witnesses including the victim, the informant and the Investigating Officer have been examined.

It Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.25964 of 2024(5)
dt.14-08-2024 is further submitted that the trial of this case will likely to be concluded within two months from today.
4. Considering the submissions made in the report, I am not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner named above.
The prayer for bail is hereby rejected.
